translations.web: He said, “I will hide my face from them. I will see what their end will be; for they are a very perverse generation, children in whom is no faithfulness.
translations.bsb: He said: “I will hide My face from them; I will see what will be their end. For they are a perverse generation— children of unfaithfulness.
translations.kjv: And he said, I will hide my face from them, I will see what their end shall be: for they are a very froward generation, children in whom is no faith.
translations.asv: And he said, I will hide my face from them, I will see what their end shall be: For they are a very perverse generation, Children in whom is no faithfulness.
